1. (Currently amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, and wherein the speaker further comprises a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36) of less than 0.5cm3.
